description: No clean concept found. Weak tendency only: fires somewhat more often in early-to-middle positions (under ~20 stones) where the opponent's stone is on top of column 2 at height 1 or 3, and in very early games with opponent stones on the bottom of columns 2 and 6. Activation flips sharply between consecutive plies, so it depends on whose stones are whose across the whole board rather than on any single pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes every column's probability by at most 0.04 (11 positions).
notes: Three different hypotheses scored: early game + last move col 2/3 (F1 0.094, AUROC 0.575), opponent on top of col 2 at odd height (F1 0.110, AUROC 0.574, best, submitted), hand-weighted mix of single-feature enrichments (F1 0.102). Simulation share is negative for all. 4-stone grids show O at (0,2)+(0,6) fires but it is not mirror-symmetric and does not generalise. The first synthesis is the dev-max game itself (ties 2.864); others reach 2.68. Likely a distributed or random direction.
